event.arrival.text: The airlock closes behind us. Outside lies a red wilderness. Inside the greenhouse, the planting trays need care. We have fourteen Martian days to keep the crew safe and send our research to Earth. Where should we begin?
event.delivery.text: The terminal's transmission light comes on. Research stored here has not yet reached Earth. They need to hear from us. But we also need time for food, rest, and tomorrow.
event.dust.text: Sunlight reaches the panels, but a thin layer of dust blocks it. Cleaning them means giving up today's other work. Waiting will leave us with less power for the days ahead.
event.supply.text: A crew member opens the food cabinet, then looks toward the greenhouse. The plants need care, but research cannot wait forever. Should we spend today with the crops, or keep to our plan?
event.routine.text: The wind sounds distant. Equipment hums quietly inside. Our routine check found no urgent problems. For once, we can choose how to spend the day.
event.sandstorm.text: Dust swallows the distant ridge. Sand keeps tapping against the window. We must stay inside. Dust is settling on the solar panels, so every use of power needs careful thought.

event.E01.title: Three Knocks
event.E01.text: A tapping sound repeats at the hatch. A supply case hangs outside; its strap looks uneven.
event.E01.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E02.title: Clicking Solar Panel
event.E02.text: The panel clicks when it turns. Today it stopped short of its usual position.
event.E02.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E03.title: The Shorter Night
event.E03.text: The battery reads full, but the low-power warning comes earlier despite similar use.
event.E03.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E04.title: The Thirsty Greenhouse
event.E04.text: The display asks for more water, but the growing medium looks damp.
event.E04.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E05.title: The Robot Drops Things
event.E05.text: The robot returns with fewer samples. Its camera shows a rock slipping from its grasp.
event.E05.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E06.title: The Flickering Antenna
event.E06.text: The signal cuts out whenever the antenna moves, then returns when it stops.
event.E06.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E07.title: The Longer Warm Up
event.E07.text: One room warms slowly. The heater runs more often than yesterday.
event.E07.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E08.title: The Whistling Vent
event.E08.text: A vent whistles and the airflow feels weaker.
event.E08.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E09.title: The Sluggish Watering System
event.E09.text: Water arrives at one growing tray later than it used to. The pump keeps running.
event.E09.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E10.title: One Spare Two Failures
event.E10.text: The greenhouse pump flickers. The antenna sometimes refuses to move.
event.E10.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E11.title: Your Experiment Is Dinner
event.E11.text: The crop is ready to eat. Keeping some for science would use food and care time you may need later.
event.E11.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E12.title: Outdated Advice
event.E12.text: Earth says “Do not restart,” but their instructions describe the setup you changed earlier.
event.E12.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E13.title: The Robot Is Stuck
event.E13.text: Your rover has stopped in loose ground with a full sample box. Repeated attempts are draining its battery.
event.E13.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E14.title: An Empty Chair
event.E14.text: Your crewmate asks for a break. A short-lived observation opportunity arrives just as they sit down.
event.E14.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E15.title: The Unlabelled Samples
event.E15.text: A spill has blurred two sample labels. You cannot confidently match them to their collection sites.
event.E15.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E16.title: The Last Day Shortcut
event.E16.text: Your final transmission fails. A greenhouse part could restore the antenna, but the next crew needs that greenhouse.
event.E16.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E17.title: A Spill in the Wrong Place
event.E17.text: A leaking drink pouch has reached the edge of an experiment rack.
event.E17.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E18.title: The Backup Fails Too
event.E18.text: A sharp impact is followed by darkness outside. Both power indicators turn red.
event.E18.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E19.title: The Shelter Decision
event.E19.text: The radiation monitor warns against outdoor work. You can move into the protected area, but the experiment outside will have to wait.
event.E19.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.
event.E20.title: The Fading Panels
event.E20.text: The panels look duller than before. Even at midday, the power display climbs more slowly.
event.E20.summaryLine: CDS event staged; no gameplay outcome committed.

space.rules.heating: Morning heating cost when the lab is open
space.lightDefinition: Light time means how long a radio signal travels one way.
space.compression: Guidance delay uses ceil(round-trip minutes / 30), capped at 1–2 Sols, including scheduling. It is a game rule, not actual travel days.
space.randomBoundary: Outcomes in this prototype are authored and deterministic. The source does not predict equipment failures, crew injury or these exact outcomes.
space.compareExplanation: The source cases differ; the starting outpost, selected tools and random seed stay comparable.
space.compareRestricted: In this simulation, crew EVA is unavailable on Sols 3 and 8.
space.compareCaution: In this simulation, crew EVA costs 1 extra E on Sols 3 and 8.
space.sameStart: Replay starts a separate mission and preserves the previous save.
space.unavailable: Space-data input was unavailable. Choose a historical replay.
dependency.spaceAdvisory: The selected Mars advisory scenario pauses crew EVA today. Use indoor work or wait.

sampling.title: Sample collection
sampling.rules: Store up to 3 samples. Each study consumes one whole sample and one day's work for 20 research data. Collection does not use daily work.
sampling.planTomorrow: Plan a crew expedition for tomorrow
sampling.plannedHint: Depart tomorrow. Clear-weather trips return after one day with fatigue; sandstorm trips take two days and return unconscious. Recovery requires two fully fed days, counting the return day. Uncheck to cancel.
sampling.selectHint: Check the box and select a crew member. Sandstorms extend trips to two days and cause unconsciousness; other EVA restrictions may still cancel departure.
error.noSamples: No samples left. Collect a sample before laboratory research.
error.crewAway: This crew member is away collecting samples.
error.crewFatigued: Still recovering from fatigue; cannot schedule an expedition.
error.expeditionTooLate: Not enough mission time remains to complete another expedition.
error.robotAlreadyCollected: The robot has already collected a sample today.
error.crewResting: No rested crew member is available. Choose rest or standby.

scene.cue.E03: Low power already? Same work as yesterday…
scene.cue.E04: More water? But the soil is still wet!
scene.cue.E05: The robot keeps dropping our samples!
scene.cue.E07: Still cold in the lab. The heater is working hard.
scene.cue.E09: This tray gets water late. The pump keeps running.
scene.cue.E10: Pump and antenna trouble. Only one spare!
scene.cue.E11: Ready to harvest! Dinner or science?
scene.cue.E12: Earth says “don’t restart”… but we changed that setup!
scene.cue.E13: Rover stuck! Its full sample box is out there.
scene.cue.E14: I need a break… but the observation window is closing.
scene.cue.E15: These two labels got wet. Which sample is which?
scene.cue.E16: Last transmission failed! Borrow a greenhouse part?
scene.cue.E17: Oops! My drink is leaking toward the experiment!
scene.cue.E18: CRACK! Both power lights are red!
scene.cue.E20: Full sun… but the panels are making less power.
scene.description.E01: You hear three knocks at the wall. A supply case outside is hanging loose.
scene.description.E02: A solar panel clicks and stops turning too soon.
scene.description.E03: The low-power warning comes earlier than yesterday.
scene.description.E04: The greenhouse asks for water, but the soil is already damp.
scene.description.E05: The robot keeps dropping samples from its grasp.
scene.description.E06: The signal cuts out whenever the antenna moves.
scene.description.E07: The lab stays cold even while its heater keeps running.
scene.description.E08: A vent whistles. Less air is coming through.
scene.description.E09: One tray gets water late while the pump keeps running.
scene.description.E10: The pump and antenna are failing. Only one spare remains.
scene.description.E11: The crop is ready. You can use it for food or research.
scene.description.E12: Earth's advice describes the old setup, not your current equipment.
scene.description.E13: The rover is stuck outside with a full box of samples.
scene.description.E14: Your crewmate needs rest, but an observation opportunity is almost over.
scene.description.E15: A spill has blurred two sample labels.
scene.description.E16: The final transmission fails. A greenhouse part could fix the antenna.
scene.description.E17: A drink pouch is leaking beside the experiment rack.
scene.description.E18: You hear a sharp impact. Both power indicators turn red.
scene.description.E19: The radiation monitor warns you to stay inside.
scene.description.E20: The solar panels produce less power, even in full sun.
events.fatigue.title: Crew recovery
events.fatigue.description: This astronaut is tired. Recovery continues each night; lighting affects its speed.
events.fatigue.summary: The tired astronaut continues their scheduled recovery.
tools.scene.robot: Collect a sample · 4 E · no crew fatigue or daily work used
ending.title: THE END
ending.openJournal: Click to view the mission journal
ending.missingLog: This older save did not retain this day’s log.
ending.eventUnresolved: This event was still unresolved when the mission ended.
ending.TGE.name: True Good End · Home with the research
ending.GE.name: Good End · Safe return
ending.GEQ.name: Good End? · Research left for Earth
ending.BE.name: Bad End · The silent outpost
outcome.sacrifice: Earth has received enough research to complete the mission, but the crew can no longer continue. Their work reached home; they did not.
summary.crewLost: Crew health reached zero. The mission ended.
summary.allCrewUnconscious: Every crew member fell unconscious. The mission ended.
events.fatigue.endingSummary: A crewmate returned exhausted and needed to recover inside the outpost.
event.arrival.endingSummary: We arrived at the outpost and planned our first day.
event.delivery.endingSummary: We checked the communication link with Earth.
event.dust.endingSummary: Dust covered the solar panels, threatening the power supply.
event.supply.endingSummary: We reviewed the greenhouse and stores to plan our supplies.
event.routine.endingSummary: The crew carried out a routine outpost check.
event.sandstorm.endingSummary: A sandstorm swept over the outpost as we planned the day.
event.E01.endingSummary: A supply case hung loose outside the airlock; we decided whether to recover its spare part.
event.E02.endingSummary: A faulty solar panel bracket prevented normal sun tracking.
event.E03.endingSummary: The battery ran low earlier than expected, shortening the night-time power supply.
event.E04.endingSummary: Greenhouse moisture readings disagreed with conditions in the trays, prompting a care decision.
event.E05.endingSummary: The robot lost its grip on rocks and returned with fewer samples.
event.E06.endingSummary: The antenna lost its signal while moving, making communication unreliable.
event.E07.endingSummary: The laboratory warmed too slowly; we decided whether to repair it or close the room.
event.E08.endingSummary: Airflow weakened; we chose between replacing the filter and using standby ventilation.
event.E09.endingSummary: A slow watering line forced a decision between clearing it and isolating the affected tray.
event.E10.endingSummary: The greenhouse and antenna failed at the same time, competing for a limited spare.
event.E11.endingSummary: A crop batch matured, forcing a choice between food and research.
event.E12.endingSummary: Earth sent advice for an outdated setup; we decided how to restore the laboratory.
event.E13.endingSummary: The robot became stuck in soft ground while carrying samples.
event.E14.endingSummary: A crewmate needed rest just as a brief observation opportunity appeared.
event.E15.endingSummary: Spilled liquid blurred sample labels, forcing us to reconsider their research value.
event.E16.endingSummary: The final transmission failed; we decided whether to borrow a greenhouse part to repair the antenna.
event.E17.endingSummary: A leaking drink reached the experiment rack, prompting an equipment safety decision.
event.E18.endingSummary: An impact triggered alarms in both power systems, leaving the outpost without a reliable backup.
event.E19.endingSummary: A radiation advisory halted outdoor work; we chose how to operate while sheltered.
event.E20.endingSummary: Solar output declined; we decided whether to clean the panels or reduce the power budget.
event.emergency_clean.endingSummary: A storm or low power prevented normal cleaning; we considered a manual trip at a cost to crew health.

event.E02.daily.force_repair.summaryLine: We forced a manual repair to restore solar panel tracking. We lost 20 health, spent 1 spare and used today’s work, without toolkit or power.

event.E04.daily.force_repair.summaryLine: We forced a manual repair to calibrate the greenhouse sensor and restore crop care to 3 E. We lost 20 health and used today’s work, without toolkit or power.

event.E07.daily.force_repair.description: No toolkit or power required. Lose 20 health, spend 1 spare and use today’s work. Seal the laboratory gap and restore lab access.
event.E07.daily.force_repair.summaryLine: We forced a manual repair to seal the laboratory gap and restore lab access. We lost 20 health, spent 1 spare and used today’s work, without toolkit or power.
event.E09.daily.force_repair.label: Force a manual repair
event.E09.daily.force_repair.description: No toolkit or power required. Lose 20 health and use today’s work. Clear the watering line and restore normal harvests to 32 food.
event.E09.daily.force_repair.summaryLine: We forced a manual repair to clear the watering line and restore normal harvests to 32 food. We lost 20 health and used today’s work, without toolkit or power.
action.force_repair.label: Force a manual panel repair
action.force_repair.narrative: No toolkit or power required. Lose 20 health and use today’s work to clear dust and restore panel tracking, even during a sandstorm.
action.force_repair.summary: We manually repaired the solar panels, clearing dust and restoring tracking. We lost 20 health and used today’s work without toolkit or power.
